replies.author: _Phyre
replies.body:
Here is my Judging: Aesthetics: 50/100       Gameplay: 50/100

Gameplay: - A lot of strafing areas = +1
                     - Trapping areas (where needed block hitting) = -1
                     - 19 block gap you say? (Perfect size) = +1
                     - Unknown Armor (Dont know what gear) = +0
                     - Perfect Size (Map size) = +1
                                 Overall: 52/100 Gameplay

Aesthetics: - A lot of design = +1
                      - Water (Usage of a rare map block) = +1
                      - Unknown Spawn area (Cant tell where they spawn) = +0
                      - Tree usage (Nature) = +1
                      - Textured Ground (Schematics) = +1
                                 Overall: 54/100

Total: 106/100                Ratio Rating: ✔ 

My thoughts: A really cool looking map, Really want to play it :3 +1
